speaker: GALIA
description: GALIA should sound like: Deep masculine voice; Perspiring/nervous demeanor when interrogated; Cautious and hesitant cadence; Older male/creature tone; Conversational; Fiercely loyal to Isaac for liberating him; Protective of Isaac's secrets even when pressured by his master; Deeply conflicted between duty to benefactor and devotion to Luce; Parental; Caring.
ref_text: No matter how many times you ask me… I can’t remember.
